INVALID_CREDENTIALS.title: Incorrect sign-in details
INVALID_CREDENTIALS.detail: The company, username or password do not match.

ACCOUNT_LOCKED.title: Account locked
ACCOUNT_LOCKED.detail: For security, try again in {minutes} minutes.

MFA_INVALID.title: Incorrect code
MFA_INVALID.detail: The verification code is invalid or has expired.

MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED.title: Turn on two-step verification
MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED.detail: The Owner role must turn on two-step verification before continuing.

FORBIDDEN.title: Not allowed
FORBIDDEN.detail: Your role does not allow this action.

ACCESS_DENIED.title: Access denied
ACCESS_DENIED.detail: This client is assigned to another collector. The attempt was logged.

VERSION_CONFLICT.title: Concurrent changes
VERSION_CONFLICT.detail: Someone else changed this record. Reload and try again.

DUPLICATE_CLIENT.title: Possible duplicate client
DUPLICATE_CLIENT.detail: Client {code} already has the same number or ID document.

USERNAME_TAKEN.title: Username taken
USERNAME_TAKEN.detail: That username already exists in the company.

RATE_CAP_EXCEEDED.title: Rate above the legal cap
RATE_CAP_EXCEEDED.detail: The effective annual rate ({effectiveAnnual}) exceeds the current cap ({cap}). Maximum allowed rate: {maxRate}.

RATE_CAP_MISSING.title: Legal rate cap missing
RATE_CAP_MISSING.detail: Register the current maximum legal rate in Settings › Compliance before creating loans.

RATE_CAP_OVERLAP.title: Overlapping periods
RATE_CAP_OVERLAP.detail: A cap is already registered for part of that period.

LATE_FEE_EXCEEDS_CAP.title: Late fee above the cap
LATE_FEE_EXCEEDS_CAP.detail: The late fee is equivalent to an annual rate above the current cap.

INVALID_PHONE.title: Invalid number
INVALID_PHONE.detail: {phone} is not a valid phone number.

WEAK_PASSWORD.title: Weak password
WEAK_PASSWORD.detail: The password must have at least 12 characters and must not contain the username or company name.

BREACHED_PASSWORD.title: Exposed password
BREACHED_PASSWORD.detail: This password appears in public data breaches. Choose another one.

LOAN_ALREADY_PAID.title: Loan paid off
LOAN_ALREADY_PAID.detail: This loan has no balance left to pay.

PAYMENT_INVALID_AMOUNT.title: Invalid amount
PAYMENT_INVALID_AMOUNT.detail: The payment amount must be greater than zero.

PAYMENT_DATE_INVALID.title: Invalid date
PAYMENT_DATE_INVALID.detail: The payment date cannot be in the future or before the disbursement.

LAST_OWNER.title: Last owner
LAST_OWNER.detail: The company must keep at least one active Owner.

IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH.title: Idempotency key reused
IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH.detail: That key was already used with different data.

IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS.title: Operation in progress
IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS.detail: The same operation is being processed. Please wait.

RESET_TOKEN_INVALID.title: Invalid link
RESET_TOKEN_INVALID.detail: The recovery link is invalid, already used or expired.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many requests
RATE_LIMITED.detail: Please wait a moment before trying again.

INTERNAL.title: Internal error
INTERNAL.detail: An unexpected error occurred. The technical team was notified.

FILE_TOO_LARGE.title: File too large
FILE_TOO_LARGE.detail: The file exceeds the {mb} MB limit.

FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.title: File type not allowed
FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.detail: Upload a PDF or a JPG, PNG, WEBP or HEIC image.

LINK_EXPIRED.title: Link expired
LINK_EXPIRED.detail: This link is no longer valid. Open it again from COROC.

BACKUP_IN_PROGRESS.title: Backup in progress
BACKUP_IN_PROGRESS.detail: A backup is already being created. Wait for it to finish or cancel it.

BACKUP_NOT_READY.title: Backup not ready
BACKUP_NOT_READY.detail: The backup is not ready to download yet.

BACKUP_NOT_COROC.title: Invalid file
BACKUP_NOT_COROC.detail: The file is not a COROC backup.

BACKUP_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED.title: Local app backup
BACKUP_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED.detail: This backup comes from the Phase 0 local app and uses another format. It cannot be restored on the server.

BACKUP_TOO_NEW.title: Backup from a newer version
BACKUP_TOO_NEW.detail: The backup comes from a newer COROC version ({version}). Update the server before restoring it.

BACKUP_PASSWORD_OR_DAMAGED.title: Could not open the backup
BACKUP_PASSWORD_OR_DAMAGED.detail: The password is wrong or the file is damaged. Nothing was changed.

BACKUP_INTEGRITY.title: Integrity check failed
BACKUP_INTEGRITY.detail: {n} items do not match their SHA-256 fingerprint. Nothing was restored.

RESTORE_CONFIRM_NAME.title: Confirm the company name
RESTORE_CONFIRM_NAME.detail: Type the exact company name to confirm you are replacing all of its data.

RESTORE_ALREADY_APPLIED.title: Restore already applied
RESTORE_ALREADY_APPLIED.detail: This backup was already restored. Upload it again to repeat the restore.

terms.PRINCIPAL: The principal must be a positive amount.
terms.INSTALLMENTS: The number of installments must be between 1 and 3660.
terms.COLLECTION_DAYS: Choose at least one collection day.
terms.MONTHLY_DAY: The monthly collection day must be between 1 and 31.
terms.FIRST_DUE: The first installment must be after the disbursement.
terms.CURRENCY: The loan currency does not match the company currency.

plan.title: Contract and payment plan
plan.lateFeePercent: {value} per day on the overdue installment, after a {days}-day grace period
plan.lateFeeFixed: {value} per day late, after a {days}-day grace period
plan.clause: {cliente} agrees to pay {empresa} the sum of {total} in {n} {freq} installments, on the dates and in the amounts of the payment plan. Each payment is applied first to accrued late fees and then to installments in order, starting with the oldest overdue one. Any overpayment is credited to the following installments.

payoff.title: Payoff letter
payoff.body: {empresa} certifies that {cliente}{id} has paid in full the obligation under contract {contrato}, for a total of {total}, and owes nothing further in connection with that contract.

report.empty: No data for the selected filters.

verify.title: Receipt verification
verify.voided: This receipt was VOIDED because the payment was reversed.
verify.invalid: We could not find a receipt with this code.
